target_customer: Developers and product teams building Jamstack and Next.js apps who need non-technical editors to manage content
problem: Teams needed content editing and preview for apps without locking into a traditional CMS or building their own admin.
business_model: Open source core with hosted SaaS tiers, free tier plus paid plans

founders.name: Scott Moss
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was an engineer at Netflix and a former VC.

founders.name: Michael Moss
founders.background_notes: Listed as Founder and CPO on the YC page.

founders.name: Patrick Stapleton
founders.background_notes: Listed as Founder and CTO on the YC page, known as PatrickJS.

exit.reason: YC and a directory list Tipe inactive but tipe.io still serves the product as a Private Release with no shutdown notice.

competitors.name: Contentstack
competitors.traction_then: Press in May 2018 about doubling down on its headless CMS

competitors.name: Contentful
competitors.traction_then: Included in a May 2018 headless CMS roundup, republished later

competitors.name: Cosmic JS
competitors.traction_then: Included in the same May 2018 roundup

technical_complexity.rationale: A CMS with API generation, previews, image handling and a CDN is standard engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Content stored in a CMS creates some lock in, but open source rivals like Strapi and Sanity offered alternatives.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Funded rivals existed; Strapi later raised a $31M round led by CRV in 2022. No source shows an incumbent copying Tipe.

market_need_then: Headless CMS adoption was growing with the Jamstack trend, with many vendors in 2018 roundups.

identity.voice_and_tone: Developer focused with testimonials from well known developers on its site.

branding.community_and_virality: Open source with a GitHub organization and site testimonials from Kent C. Dodds and Brandon Roberts; the CTO is a known JavaScript community figure.

brand_strength.rationale: A niche developer brand with no mainstream press found; the spelling is easy to confuse with type or tip.

outcome_analysis: Tipe joined YC in winter 2018 and built an open source headless CMS, raising a $2.1M seed led by CRV, which a database dates to September 2020. The product site still runs as a private release. The directory marks it inactive but no shutdown or acquisition was found, so the outcome is unknown and no failure cause is stated in any source.
notes: The seed round rests on CB Insights (date 2020-09-09, $2.1M) and Precursor Ventures' portfolio page listing a 2020 seed; a search summary said the company's own post is dated January 2024, which conflicts and may be a repost. Amount and investors come from a search summary of the company post and CB Insights and are not independently confirmed in a second outlet. The Contentstack source was identified from a search result title only. The roundup source for Contentful and Cosmic JS was republished in 2020 and the original date of May 2018 comes from its text as summarized. The Moss brothers relationship is not stated in sources.
